title: Migrate app/ from the legacy callback router to tiny-http
prompt: Read MIGRATION.md and migrate everything under app/ from lib/legacy/router.mjs to lib/tiny-http.mjs. Behavior must stay exactly as documented there (the table is the contract), lib/ must not be modified, app/server.mjs keeps exporting handle(req) -> {status, body}, the admin guard becomes one app.use middleware, and nothing under app/ may import lib/legacy afterwards. Exercise the endpoints yourself to confirm before answering.
